categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in four segments: aerospace products, satellite communication and measurement & control testing equipment, aviation products, and aerospace process equipment. These segments focus on providing technical solutions and manufacturing support for aerospace research institutes and main contractors in China. The company serves national major aerospace projects including manned spaceflight, lunar exploration, Mars exploration, Beidou navigation, and large aircraft manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 17 core technologies including complex microwave feed component design and manufacturing, starborne waveguide slot array antenna manufacturing and welding, large thin-wall polyimide injection molding, aerospace composite material tooling design, satellite communication antenna subsystem design, lightweight deployable reflector design, high-precision servo tracking control, and high-precision aerospace composite parts manufacturing. Production methods emphasize precision CNC machining, composite material automated manufacturing, laser welding, and advanced testing including microwave anechoic chambers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned aerospace and aviation enterprises and research institutes such as China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Electronics Technology Group, China Aviation Industry Corporation, China Commercial Aircraft Corporation, and their subsidiaries. The company mainly serves the aerospace and defense sectors, including satellite manufacturers, rocket and spacecraft developers, and aircraft manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with major operations and facilities located in Changsha, Hunan Province, and subsidiaries in Chengdu and Zigong. Its sales and services are focused on domestic aerospace and aviation markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace supply chain, providing design, manufacturing, assembly, and testing of aerospace components, satellite communication equipment, and aerospace tooling. It acts as a key supplier to large aerospace system integrators and research institutes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing core aerospace technologies, expanding satellite communication and measurement equipment capabilities, developing automated and intelligent manufacturing lines for composite materials, and enhancing aerospace tooling products. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on high-precision manufacturing, lightweight composite structures, and integrated antenna systems. It also emphasizes intellectual property protection and continuous innovation to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized aerospace products and technical services to government-affiliated aerospace research institutes and main contractors. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with pricing based on technical complexity, material consumption, and competitive factors. It also receives government subsidies and grants related to technology development and industrial projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in specialized aerospace components, satellite communication antennas, and aerospace tooling, competing with other state-owned and private aerospace manufacturers. It holds a strong market position in niche segments such as starborne microwave components and satellite ground station equipment, benefiting from its comprehensive technology portfolio and close relationships with major aerospace groups.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 508 million, representing an 11.36% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 101.57 million, a 24.42% decrease from the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 2.44 billion, growing 4.61%, while net assets slightly declined by 2.36% to RMB 1.63 billion. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory with increased R&D investment accounting for 11.9% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive aerospace technology system, covering design, simulation, precision manufacturing, assembly, and testing, enabling it to deliver high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective aerospace components and systems. Its unique value lies in proprietary core technologies, integrated manufacturing capabilities, and strong customer relationships with major national aerospace entities. The company also highlights its rapid response to customized orders, strict quality control, and continuous innovation in advanced materials and intelligent manufacturing.
